agreedBellaRules.source: Qualified physical file own supported descriptor: audio QuantizationBits or picture ComponentDepth as complete big-endian UInt32; RGBA PixelLayout as fixed16 bytes of eight interleaved code/depth pairs. Checked type, width, ownership and bounds; no text decoding or borrowed master/other-file value.
agreedBellaRules.interpretation: Carry verified format-aware rules and useful cases into small fresh C++17/Qt helpers. Preserve necessary raw coded value, full coding identifier and numeric representation; do not treat picture253/254/255 as literal bit counts or apply picture float codes to audio.
agreedBellaRules.rgbaPadding: Require an interpretable meaningful prefix followed only by numeric00/00 or nativeASCII30/00 end/padding forms within the16-byte bound. Reject arbitrary nonpadding tails; do not reproduce native all-slot count/copy quirks.
agreedBellaRules.rgbaDepth: Every meaningful non-fill component must be supported and interpreted. Use the common interpreted width only when all agree, including alpha-only files. Never sum widths, choose the first component, replace colour depth with separate alpha depth or publish a partial result.
agreedBellaRules.unavailable: Missing, damaged, unsupported, mixed-width, palette-only/unsupported meanings or unverified LSB combinations supply no single MXF Bit Depth. Keep the physical file and independent facts; no guessed default or codec-capability substitute.
agreedBellaRules.retentionAndDisplay: Keep one numeric interpreted depth and necessary format/source/availability context, with compact raw code/layout only where required. Generate labels when displayed and sort numerically. No new visible alpha/sample-format column.
agreedBellaRules.lifetime: At most eight component entries and small new fixed-width/endian helpers. Extract wanted facts during independently required header parsing, release temporary header/reference structures and preserve the current Compression contract.
